_comment: Configuration for the ECCS/HPCI reactor case (Section 5, Supplement S3). Every value tagged 'source: manuscript' is stated in the main paper or supplement. Values tagged 'source: RECONSTRUCTED' were not in the manuscript (marked [[fill from repository]] in S3) and were calibrated by scripts/calibrate_multipliers.py so that the exact BN posteriors match the Monte Carlo means reported in S3.4. The authors must replace them with the elicited parent sets and multipliers before release.

base_rates.source: manuscript (S3.2): INL HPCI system study 1998-2022 (pump/turbine), INL 2021 component update (valve, sensor)

parents.source: RECONSTRUCTED (S3.1 says each failure mode has one to three stressor parents)

multipliers.source: RECONSTRUCTED: m_{i,pa} = product over abnormal parents of the per-parent factor below (m = 1 when all parents nominal); factors calibrated to the S3.4 scenario posteriors

weights_ahp.source: manuscript (S3.3): triangular pairwise comparisons on Saaty's scale

reported_posterior_means.source: manuscript (S3.4), used only by calibrate_multipliers.py and as a check
